page.layout: One printed page, title page. Centred title lines from top to bottom, then an engraved vignette (wreath with a seated figure) in the middle, then the imprint lines at the foot. A library stamp (ISL / 00 22325) at the top and a handwritten date (1647) at the bottom are not printed text and are left out.
page.notes: The engraving shows a wreath enclosing a seated figure with a tablet above; no text is legible inside it apart from the small tablet, which is not transcribed. The date is printed as cIↄ Iↄ c XLVII, i.e. MDCXLVII (1647). The "Antvverpiani" line keeps the printed spelling with w-style v.
